scope: Final selected25 NEW source-card metadata for PR4-DATA2 curation handback only; no runtime/production seed changes. Retained5 old-card metadata remain in source-equipment-audit.json.
method: Equipment unique normalized codes are ordered by first explicit selected preparation/cooking mention in main recipe, then necessary linked recipe-specific skill/equipment sections in document order. Choose one source-explicit alternative, preserve words/location, do not infer utensils from chopping/grating/covering/grilling verbs. Exclude consumable foil/parchment/wax paper, serving-only dishes/glasses, optional variants and generic safety/tutorial vocabulary not necessary to selected recipe. Times are exact source fields or labeled stages; never infer a missing preparation/overall duration.
